title: 🧹 Refactor IP extraction logic
body:
## 🧹 Code Health Improvement Task

### 🎯 What
Replaced the redundant, hardcoded IP resolution logic (which included a '127.0.0.1' fallback) with a centralized `getClientIp` utility function across the codebase.

### 💡 Why
This improves the maintainability and readability of the codebase by removing duplicate logic and ensuring a consistent, secure IP resolution approach. It makes the route files cleaner.

### ✅ Verification
Verified by ensuring the `check-route.test.ts` and `explain-route.test.ts` pass, successfully completing all pre-commit checks and code review.

### ✨ Result
Improved code health and centralized IP extraction logic.
